itemized.notes: A 3-page filing delivered as a 4-page PDF: p1 cover, p2 Summary Page, p3 Schedule A, p4 Schedule B. The filer did NOT use the county's grid form for the schedules - she typed her own, so there is no 'SUBTOTAL FOR THIS PAGE' row, only a TOTAL. p3 is rotated 90 degrees in the PDF. PRIVACY: nothing to record - the Complete Mailing Address column is printed but entirely blank (filer omission, not a county redaction). Both schedules print a '* In Kind' legend but NO row carries the asterisk, so no row is flagged in-kind - the legend is boilerplate here. Two Schedule A rows are the filer's own aggregates ('Under $50', $40.00 and $35.00) and one is a receipt line rather than a donor ('PayPal Dividends', $0.14); all three are inside the printed TOTAL and are emitted with needs_review=1. Two Schedule B rows pay the CANDIDATE herself (Janice Auger, $106.81 'Repay Loan (from paypal account)' and $6,212.44 'Payment of campaign loans'); one Schedule B row has a blank Purpose cell ('Pay Pal fees'). The largest single expenditure is a $3,090.00 contribution back to the Utah Republican Party, which also appears on Schedule A as a $1,500.00 contributor.
